outcome: need for neonatal intensive care unit admission
cohort: 164 patients with a history of previous cesarean section undergoing a repeat cesarean section at 38 weeks gestational age or beyond
finding: The onset of labor and related labor pain in patients with a history of previous cesarean section undergoing a repeat cesarean section was associated with higher cord blood pH values and a lower need for neonatal intensive care unit admission.
mod_finding: Neonatal respiratory disorders were reduced in patients who had a cesarean section after the onset of labor or labor pain compared to those who had a scheduled cesarean section.
